name: Heroine wa Tomodachi Desu ka? Koibito Desu ka? Soretomo Tomefure Desu ka? W
original_name: 彼女は友達ですか？　恋人ですか？　それともトメフレですか？　Ｗ
source:
The stories and heroines are completely separate for each protagonist.

Kashiwaba Yuki arc:
The season is late fall and the tomefure girls are still staying at Yuki's house.
One day, Sakurako came up with an idea to go to the Halloween event hosted at a famous theme park. Everyone else protested, as they had no way of getting tickets on such a quick notice, but then Sayaka pulled something out of her bag...

Takamine Yuuji arc:
Christmas has already passed with the New Year just around the corner, and Yuuji is eating lunch home alone. He had been living with the tomefure girls for a long time, but they all decided to go back home for the holidays. It's been a long time since he lived on his own. As he was thinking about how to spend New Year's Eve, something happened...

[Translated from [url=https://app.candysoft.jp/products/dessertsoft/tomefureW/story]the official site[/url].]
translation:
每个主角的故事和女主角都是完全独立的。

柏叶由希篇：
时节已是深秋，tomefure女孩们仍然住在Yuki家里。
有一天，樱子突发奇想，要去参加一个著名主题公园举办的万圣节活动。其他人都抗议，因为他们没办法这么快就拿到票，但随后沙耶香从包里拿出了一样东西……

高峰雄二剧情：
圣诞节已经过去，新年即将来临，雄二独自在家吃午饭。他和tomefu女孩们住了很长一段时间，但她们都决定回家过节。他已经很久没有独自生活了。正当他想着如何度过除夕之夜时，发生了一件事情……

[翻译自[url=https://app.candysoft.jp/products/dessertsoft/tomefureW/story]官方网站[/url]。]
